observations.why: Directive issued in settled, confident register — establishing cadence without urgency or alarm.
Aphoristic framing that raises stakes — an unrehearsed rollback framed as no rollback at all carries urgency-as-worry.
Structured cadence entry in a settled, organizational register — no heightened arousal.
Ownership attribution in a neutral, settled register — no affective charge.

mints.name: StakesByNegation
mints.title: a thing we have not done is a thing we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker raising stakes by negating the value of an unperformed action — framing absence as loss?
